description: This file defines the ModuleNode class, which models a module in a PCB design context, extending PcbNode and managing associated pads and position points.

classes.name: ModuleNode
classes.description: Represents a module in a PCB, containing pads, position, and reference data.

methods.name: ModuleNode
methods.description: Constructor initializing ModuleNode with name, index, and child elements; extracts pads, position, and reference.

methods.name: getReference
methods.description: Returns the reference string associated with this module.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ModuleNode object.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the module is connected to a given point.
